title: Before They Are Hanged
author: Joe Abercrombie
summary: Second in the First Law trilogy. A crippled torturer is sent to defend a besieged southern city, while a wizard leads a mismatched band on a quest to the edge of the known world.
readIf: you like bleak, funny fantasy where nobody is purely good and violence is never glamorous.
skipIf: you haven't read the first book, since the characters and their alliances arrive already formed.

pairings.reason: The opening book of this trilogy, which sets up the characters and tone you are picking up here.
Shares the sardonic voice and a crew of flawed people, with more heist and less war.
A weary, cynical mercenary fantasy narrated from deep inside the dirty side of a war.
